verdict.rationale: Unleash documents only one-off, point-in-time scheduling: date-based constraints for a feature release, and scheduled change requests applied at a specific moment. Its release templates progress automatically based on metrics, which is not a time-based recurring schedule. There is no evidence of recurring jobs or workflows (cron-like or repeating schedules), so a one-off action cannot stand in for the recurring capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
